description_en: Deletes the backup files of an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于删除RDS MySQL的目标用户备份
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-user-backup-file --backup-id b-w1haya7e4i250000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteUserBackupFile

parameters.help_en: The ID of the full backup file. You can call the ListUserBackupFiles operation to query the information about all full backup files in a region
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
